title: vettd passive-observer telemetry field gate (spike #828)
description: The complete list of fields that may leave the machine in a passive-observer telemetry payload, in the form a gate script consumes. Every leaf path of a written payload must appear in `fields` (an unknown key fails, mirroring contract/disclosure.rs::validate_payload_coverage), every field maps to exactly one disclosure category, every enum is closed, and every string leaf that is not a hash, day, or allowed uuid must pass every `forbiddenValuePatterns` regex and every `dynamicForbids` set. A key-path walker cannot see a path inside a string; the value-level rules are what make 'logs never leave the machine' checkable on the payload rather than on the code.
pathSyntax: dot-joined keys; array elements as []; leaf paths only; nullable objects are listed once as type object with nullable=true and their children are listed as leaves.

allowed: relative durations in ms as mergeable stats
content-derived asset hashes and HMAC pseudonyms
a coarse task category from a published tool-mix rule set
bookkeeping: versions, device id, harness id and semver, run pseudonym, loaded-set hash, attribution tier, evidence basis, coverage
never: user-chosen identifiers (session slugs, agent ids, OpenClaw agent ids, Hermes session titles)
harness session, message, request, or tool-use ids
wall-clock timestamps finer than a UTC day

disclosureCategories.name: TelemetryBookkeeping
disclosureCategories.label: Telemetry bookkeeping
disclosureCategories.description: envelope, extractor, gate, and collector versions

disclosureCategories.name: ObservationDay
disclosureCategories.label: Observation day
disclosureCategories.description: UTC calendar day of emission and of each observed run start; no finer time resolution is transmitted

disclosureCategories.name: DeviceIdentity
disclosureCategories.label: Device identity
disclosureCategories.description: the persisted scanner device id and a per-run pseudonym derived from a device-local secret; the harness session id itself is never transmitted

disclosureCategories.name: HarnessIdentity
disclosureCategories.label: Harness identity
disclosureCategories.description: which supported harness produced the run, its semantic version, and a coarse entrypoint class

disclosureCategories.name: ModelIdentity
disclosureCategories.label: Model identity
disclosureCategories.description: the allowlisted model identifier reported by the harness for the run, or 'other'

disclosureCategories.name: RunShape
disclosureCategories.label: Run shape
disclosureCategories.description: closed-enum descriptors of the run: effort, permission mode, task category from a published tool-mix rule set, loaded-set basis, run outcome

disclosureCategories.name: RunOutcomeCounts
disclosureCategories.label: Run outcome counts
disclosureCategories.description: integer counts per run: turns, tool calls, failures by class, denials, sub-agent runs, compactions, unpaired calls, repeated near-identical calls

disclosureCategories.name: RunTokenTotals
disclosureCategories.label: Run token totals
disclosureCategories.description: token totals per run by provider bucket (nullable per provider) and the basis they were read from; never a cost figure

disclosureCategories.name: AssetIdentityHash
disclosureCategories.label: Asset identity hashes
disclosureCategories.description: a content hash, canonical-descriptor hash, or HMAC name pseudonym per asset with its type and key basis; never a name or path

disclosureCategories.name: AssetLoadedSet
disclosureCategories.label: Loaded set
disclosureCategories.description: the loaded-set hash per run, the membership list as asset hashes, and per-asset attribution tier and binding

disclosureCategories.name: AssetOutcomeCounts
disclosureCategories.label: Asset outcome counts
disclosureCategories.description: per asset per run: invocation count, failures by class, harness-native corroboration count

disclosureCategories.name: AssetTimingStats
disclosureCategories.label: Asset timing stats
disclosureCategories.description: per asset per run: mergeable stats (n, sum, min, max, sumsq) of per-invocation latency in ms from harness timestamps

disclosureCategories.name: AssetTokenStats
disclosureCategories.label: Asset token stats
disclosureCategories.description: per asset per run: mergeable stats of tokens attributed to the asset where attribution is exact (sub-agent runs), and a locally estimated context-cost figure with its method

disclosureCategories.name: CoverageMetadata
disclosureCategories.label: Coverage metadata
disclosureCategories.description: what the collector saw and did not see, so silence is distinguishable from nothing to report

envelope_version.reason: Schema version of this payload; the cloud validates against the matching envelope schema.

extractor_version.reason: Deterministic extractor identity including the task-category rule-set version; a re-extraction with a different version is a different observation.

gate_version.reason: Which field gate the emitter enforced; lets the cloud reject payloads produced under an older allowlist.

emitted_day.reason: UTC day the payload was written; coarse enough not to record when a person works.

resource.device_id.reason: The persisted scanner_uuid from identity.rs so the cloud can join telemetry to the inventory the same device submitted under the scan disclosure. The prototype emits the null-UUID placeholder.

resource.device_id_source.reason: Whether device_id is the real persisted id or a placeholder, so placeholder rows are never joined.

resource.harness.reason: Harness identity is attribution (#881 deferral, #965); a closed enum, never the harness's own display name.

resource.harness_version.reason: Log formats change with harness releases; the version stratifies parse confidence. Plain MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH only: prerelease and build metadata are dropped to 'unknown' because a build string can carry a hostname or a commit.

records[].run_id.reason: HMAC(device-local observer secret, harness session id): deterministic locally so re-extraction is idempotent, unlinkable remotely because the secret never egresses.

records[].observed_day.reason: UTC day of the session's first harness timestamp; the recency and staleness key at the coarsest resolution that still supports #886 observedAt.

records[].model.reason: Model id as reported by the harness, restricted to a closed list versioned with this gate; anything else (a custom provider name, a fine-tune label, a model released after this gate) becomes 'other'. A prefix pattern was rejected because a user-named model such as claude-<org>-<project> would pass it and carry a name.

records[].entrypoint_class.reason: Coarse class of how the harness was launched; a confounder for tool mix and denial rates, recorded so it can be stratified or visibly pooled.

records[].effort.reason: Reasoning effort setting; a confounder for token totals.

records[].permission_mode.reason: Permission mode; a confounder for user-denial counts.

records[].task_category.reason: Coarse task category from the published tool-mix rule set in prototype/taskcat.py; derived without reading content, and the underlying shares never egress.

records[].bom_version.reason: sha256 over the sorted asset hashes of the loaded set for this run segment; session-level signals attach here, not to any single asset (ADR-001 alignment).

records[].loaded_set_basis.reason: Whether the loaded set came from the harness's own log, from filesystem reconstruction, or is absent.

records[].run_outcome.reason: How the run ended as far as the log shows; completion of the task is not observable and is never claimed.

records[].counts.turns.reason: User prompt turns in the run; not 'turns to completion'.

records[].counts.tool_calls.reason: Total tool_use blocks including built-in tools.

records[].counts.tool_failures.reason: Tool results flagged as errors by the harness, excluding user denials.

records[].counts.user_denials.reason: Permission prompts the user declined; separated so they never count toward an asset's non-success rate.

records[].counts.subagent_runs.reason: Child transcripts linked to this run.

records[].counts.compactions.reason: Context compactions observed; a session-boundary marker.

records[].counts.unpaired_tool_uses.reason: tool_use blocks with no matching result in the log; coverage, not failure.

records[].counts.repeated_tool_calls.reason: Non-convergence indicator: tool calls whose (name, canonical-input hash) repeats three or more times in the run; the input hash is computed locally and discarded.

records[].tokens.input.reason: Uncached input tokens summed over deduplicated API responses.

records[].tokens.cache_creation.reason: Provider-specific bucket; null where the provider has no such bucket.

records[].tokens.cached_input.reason: Codex-style cached-input bucket; null for providers that split creation and read.

records[].tokens.output.reason: Output tokens summed over deduplicated API responses.

records[].tokens.thinking.reason: Thinking tokens where the provider reports them; null otherwise.

records[].tokens.basis.reason: Whether totals were read from harness usage records, estimated, or absent.

records[].assets[].asset_id.reason: The only asset identifier that egresses: content hash, canonical-descriptor hash, or HMAC name pseudonym. Human-readable names live in the inventory the user consented to separately; the join is server-side on this key.

records[].assets[].asset_type.reason: Which asset type the hash identifies; rules files and prompts can never be Direct.

records[].assets[].key_basis.reason: How the hash was formed; name_hash rows have no cross-device meaning and are Inferred.

records[].assets[].tier.reason: Attribution tier that produced this row: direct, loaded, or inferred.

records[].assets[].binding.reason: How the asset hash is bound to what the harness actually loaded: exact from the log, mtime-proven from the filesystem, unproven, or not applicable.

records[].assets[].direct_evidence_avail.reason: Whether the harness log carries an explicit invocation of this asset, i.e. whether the production collector could attribute it Direct.

records[].assets[].signals.invocations.n.reason: Explicit invocations of the asset in this run; zero for loaded-only assets.

records[].assets[].signals.failures.tool.reason: Results the harness flagged as errors; counts toward the observed non-success rate.

records[].assets[].signals.failures.time.reason: Timeouts where the harness distinguishes them; counts toward the rate.

records[].assets[].signals.failures.user.reason: User declined a permission prompt; never counts toward the rate.

records[].assets[].signals.failures.inte.reason: Call cut short by session end or user interrupt; never counts toward the rate.

records[].assets[].signals.failures.unkn.reason: Unclassifiable outcome; never counts toward the rate.

records[].assets[].signals.harness_corro.reason: Count of harness-native attribution markers agreeing with this attribution (Claude Code sub-agent attribution fields); null where the harness has none.

records[].assets[].signals.latency_ms.n.reason: Number of invocations with a paired result.

records[].assets[].signals.latency_ms.su.reason: Sum of per-invocation harness-clock latencies (result timestamp minus call timestamp); with n/min/max/sumsq it merges server-side without per-call rows. Relative durations only.
Sum of squares so variance can be derived after merging; never a percentile (#965 rollup rule).

records[].assets[].signals.tokens_attrib.reason: Present only where token attribution is exact (a sub-agent run's own transcript); null otherwise. Never a heuristic share of the parent's tokens.
Mergeable sum of total tokens (input+output buckets) across those runs.
Sum of squares for merged variance.

records[].assets[].signals.context_cost_.reason: Locally estimated context cost of having the asset loaded; null when no estimate basis exists. An estimate, tagged with its method, never presented as measured.
How the estimate was made (skills load lazily in Claude Code, so listing bytes and body bytes are different costs).

bom[].asset_ids[].reason: Membership of the loaded set as asset hashes, sorted; co-occurrence is derived from this server-side.

coverage.sessions_seen.reason: Session files discovered in the window.

coverage.sessions_skipped_unparseable.reason: Sessions skipped because the reader could not parse them; a dead or outdated reader shows up here rather than as silence.

coverage.lines_unknown_type.reason: Lines of a type the reader does not understand; a harness format change shows up here.

coverage.bytes_read.reason: Bytes read, for the collector's own resource accounting.

coverage.truncated_sessions.reason: Sessions still being written when read.

coverage.cursor_state.reason: Whether this emission resumed from a persisted cursor or started fresh.

coverage.run_id_basis.reason: Whether run pseudonyms were keyed by the real device secret or a test secret; test-keyed payloads are never joined.

records[].tokens_by_model[].reason: Token buckets per model within the run: a run whose sub-agents ran on a different model must not have every token priced at the parent's model. One entry per distinct model id; the model id is allowlisted like records[].model.

records[].tokens_by_model[].model.reason: Model id as reported by the harness, restricted to a closed list versioned with this gate; anything else (a custom provider name, a fine-tune label, a model released after this gate) becomes 'other'. A prefix pattern was rejected because a user-named model such as claude-<org>-<project> would pass it and carry a name.

records[].tokens_by_model[].input.reason: Uncached input tokens for this model.

records[].tokens_by_model[].thinking.reason: Thinking tokens where reported; null otherwise.

records[].counts.loaded_set_changes.reason: Number of settled loaded-set changes inside the run (segments minus one). The record's bom_version is the set the harness listed at session start; every segment's set is in bom[] so co-occurrence per segment survives without a record per segment.

forbiddenValuePatterns.catches: any free text: every permitted string is an enum value, hash, day, version, or model id and none contains whitespace
absolute POSIX paths such as home directories, project paths, log paths
Windows drive-letter and UNC paths
already-scrubbed home-relative paths
any URL
email addresses, user@host, scoped package names
hostnames and domains; semver and model ids never end in an alphabetic TLD
timestamps finer than a day (any hour component after a date)
clock times
unix seconds or milliseconds embedded in a string (hash paths are checked by exact format instead)
harness session, agent, or request uuids anywhere except resource.device_id
tool_use, message, request, agent and Codex call ids
MCP tool and server names in harness form
API tokens including separator-less AWS access key ids, defence in depth
JSON web tokens
branch refs and full commit shas (hash paths are checked by exact format instead)
environment variable names
colon-less ISO 8601 basic timestamps such as 20260902T165647Z
IPv4 addresses and localhost
any dotted name whose last label is alphabetic (ccTLDs, new gTLDs, internal domains); version and model strings have numeric last labels and pass

dynamicForbids.description: Sets the emitter hands to the checker at run time; every string leaf is tested for substring membership against each set, case-insensitively for names.
